// This Pine Script® code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/ MPL-2.0

//@version=6
indicator("Order Blocks & Breaker Blocks", overlay = true
  , max_lines_count  = 500
  , max_labels_count = 500
  , max_boxes_count  = 500)

//------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Settings
//------------------------------------------------------------------------------
length   = input.int(10, "Swing Lookback", minval = 3, tooltip = "Number of bars used to detect swing points.")
showBull = input.int(3, "Show Last Bullish OB", minval = 0, tooltip = "Number of recent bullish order blocks to display.")
showBear = input.int(3, "Show Last Bearish OB", minval = 0, tooltip = "Number of recent bearish order blocks to display.")
useBody  = input.bool(false, "Use Candle Body", tooltip = "Use candle bodies instead of full candle ranges when building blocks.")
showVolume = input.bool(true, "Show Internal Volume", tooltip = "Display the accumulated up-volume and down-volume inside each order block and breaker block.")

//------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Style
//------------------------------------------------------------------------------
bullCss      = input.color(color.new(#2157f3, 80), "Bullish OB", inline = "bullcss", group = "Style")
bullBreakCss = input.color(color.new(#ff1100, 80), "Bullish Break", inline = "bullcss", group = "Style")
bearCss      = input.color(color.new(#ff5d00, 80), "Bearish OB", inline = "bearcss", group = "Style")
bearBreakCss = input.color(color.new(#0cb51a, 80), "Bearish Break", inline = "bearcss", group = "Style")
volumeTextCss = input.color(color.gray, "Internal Volume Text", group = "Style", tooltip = "Text color used for internal volume metrics.")
showLabels = input.bool(false, "Show Historical Polarity Changes", tooltip = "Show labels when a breaker block confirms a polarity change.")

//------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// UDTs
//------------------------------------------------------------------------------
type ob
    float top = na
    float btm = na
    int   loc = bar_index
    bool  breaker = false
    int   break_loc = na
    float buyVolume = 0.0
    float sellVolume = 0.0
    float breakerBuyVolume = 0.0
    float breakerSellVolume = 0.0

type swing
    float y = na
    int   x = na
    bool  crossed = false

//------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Functions
//------------------------------------------------------------------------------
swings(len) =>
    var os = 0
    var swing top = swing.new(na, na)
    var swing btm = swing.new(na, na)

    upper = ta.highest(len)
    lower = ta.lowest(len)

    os := high[len] > upper ? 0 : low[len] < lower ? 1 : os

    if os == 0 and os[1] != 0
        top := swing.new(high[length], bar_index[length])

    if os == 1 and os[1] != 1
        btm := swing.new(low[length], bar_index[length])

    [top, btm]

method notransp(color css) => color.rgb(color.r(css), color.g(css), color.b(css))

method volumeText(ob id, bool isBreaker) =>
    buyVolume = isBreaker ? id.breakerBuyVolume : id.buyVolume
    sellVolume = isBreaker ? id.breakerSellVolume : id.sellVolume
    totalVolume = buyVolume + sellVolume
    buyPercent = totalVolume > 0 ? buyVolume / totalVolume * 100 : 0.0
    sellPercent = totalVolume > 0 ? sellVolume / totalVolume * 100 : 0.0
    showVolume ? "Vol: " + str.tostring(totalVolume, format.volume) + "\nUp: " + str.tostring(buyPercent, "#.0") + "%  Down: " + str.tostring(sellPercent, "#.0") + "%" : ""

method display(ob id, css, breakCss) =>
    if id.breaker
        box.new(id.loc, id.top, id.break_loc, id.btm, css.notransp()
          , bgcolor = css
          , text = id.volumeText(false)
          , text_color = volumeTextCss
          , text_size = size.tiny
          , text_halign = text.align_left
          , text_valign = text.align_center
          , xloc = xloc.bar_time)

        box.new(id.break_loc, id.top, time + 1, id.btm, na
          , bgcolor = breakCss
          , text = id.volumeText(true)
          , text_color = volumeTextCss
          , text_size = size.tiny
          , text_halign = text.align_left
          , text_valign = text.align_center
          , extend = extend.right
          , xloc = xloc.bar_time)

        line.new(id.loc, id.top, id.break_loc, id.top, xloc.bar_time, color = css.notransp())
        line.new(id.loc, id.btm, id.break_loc, id.btm, xloc.bar_time, color = css.notransp())
        line.new(id.break_loc, id.top, time + 1, id.top, xloc.bar_time, extend.right, breakCss.notransp(), line.style_dashed)
        line.new(id.break_loc, id.btm, time + 1, id.btm, xloc.bar_time, extend.right, breakCss.notransp(), line.style_dashed)
    else
        box.new(id.loc, id.top, time, id.btm, na
          , bgcolor = css
          , text = id.volumeText(false)
          , text_color = volumeTextCss
          , text_size = size.tiny
          , text_halign = text.align_left
          , text_valign = text.align_center
          , extend = extend.right
          , xloc = xloc.bar_time)

        line.new(id.loc, id.top, time, id.top, xloc.bar_time, extend.right, css.notransp())
        line.new(id.loc, id.btm, time, id.btm, xloc.bar_time, extend.right, css.notransp())

//------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Detect Swings
//------------------------------------------------------------------------------
n = bar_index

[top, btm] = swings(length)
max = useBody ? math.max(close, open) : high
min = useBody ? math.min(close, open) : low
currentUpVolume = close >= open ? nz(volume, 0.0) : 0.0
currentDownVolume = close < open ? nz(volume, 0.0) : 0.0

//------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Bullish OB
//------------------------------------------------------------------------------
var bullishObArray = array.new<ob>(0)
bullBreakConf = 0

if close > top.y and not top.crossed
    top.crossed := true

    minima = max[1]
    maxima = min[1]
    loc = time[1]

    for i = 1 to (n - top.x) - 1
        minima := math.min(min[i], minima)
        maxima := minima == min[i] ? max[i] : maxima
        loc := minima == min[i] ? time[i] : loc

    buyVolume = 0.0
    sellVolume = 0.0
    for i = 1 to n - top.x
        if time[i] >= loc
            buyVolume += close[i] >= open[i] ? nz(volume[i], 0.0) : 0.0
            sellVolume += close[i] < open[i] ? nz(volume[i], 0.0) : 0.0

    bullishObArray.unshift(ob.new(maxima, minima, loc, false, na, buyVolume, sellVolume))

if bullishObArray.size() > 0
    for i = bullishObArray.size() - 1 to 0
        element = bullishObArray.get(i)

        if not element.breaker
            element.buyVolume += currentUpVolume
            element.sellVolume += currentDownVolume

            if math.min(close, open) < element.btm
                element.breaker := true
                element.break_loc := time
                element.breakerBuyVolume := currentUpVolume
                element.breakerSellVolume := currentDownVolume
        else
            element.breakerBuyVolume += currentUpVolume
            element.breakerSellVolume += currentDownVolume

            if close > element.top
                bullishObArray.remove(i)
            else if i < showBull and top.y < element.top and top.y > element.btm
                bullBreakConf := 1

if bullBreakConf > bullBreakConf[1] and showLabels
    label.new(top.x, top.y, "▼", color = na
      , textcolor = bearCss.notransp()
      , style = label.style_label_down
      , size = size.tiny)

//------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Bearish OB
//------------------------------------------------------------------------------
var bearishObArray = array.new<ob>(0)
bearBreakConf = 0

if close < btm.y and not btm.crossed
    btm.crossed := true

    minima = min[1]
    maxima = max[1]
    loc = time[1]

    for i = 1 to (n - btm.x) - 1
        maxima := math.max(max[i], maxima)
        minima := maxima == max[i] ? min[i] : minima
        loc := maxima == max[i] ? time[i] : loc

    buyVolume = 0.0
    sellVolume = 0.0
    for i = 1 to n - btm.x
        if time[i] >= loc
            buyVolume += close[i] >= open[i] ? nz(volume[i], 0.0) : 0.0
            sellVolume += close[i] < open[i] ? nz(volume[i], 0.0) : 0.0

    bearishObArray.unshift(ob.new(maxima, minima, loc, false, na, buyVolume, sellVolume))

if bearishObArray.size() > 0
    for i = bearishObArray.size() - 1 to 0
        element = bearishObArray.get(i)

        if not element.breaker
            element.buyVolume += currentUpVolume
            element.sellVolume += currentDownVolume

            if math.max(close, open) > element.top
                element.breaker := true
                element.break_loc := time
                element.breakerBuyVolume := currentUpVolume
                element.breakerSellVolume := currentDownVolume
        else
            element.breakerBuyVolume += currentUpVolume
            element.breakerSellVolume += currentDownVolume

            if close < element.btm
                bearishObArray.remove(i)
            else if i < showBear and btm.y > element.btm and btm.y < element.top
                bearBreakConf := 1

if bearBreakConf > bearBreakConf[1] and showLabels
    label.new(btm.x, btm.y, "▲", color = na
      , textcolor = bullCss.notransp()
      , style = label.style_label_up
      , size = size.tiny)

//------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Set Order Blocks
//------------------------------------------------------------------------------
for bx in box.all
    bx.delete()

for lineId in line.all
    lineId.delete()

if barstate.islast
    if showBull > 0 and bullishObArray.size() > 0
        for i = 0 to math.min(showBull - 1, bullishObArray.size() - 1)
            getOb = bullishObArray.get(i)
            getOb.display(bullCss, bullBreakCss)

    if showBear > 0 and bearishObArray.size() > 0
        for i = 0 to math.min(showBear - 1, bearishObArray.size() - 1)
            getOb = bearishObArray.get(i)
            getOb.display(bearCss, bearBreakCss)

//------------------------------------------------------------------------------
